download my ComfyUI Buildhttps://huggingface.co/datasets/StefanFalkok/ComfyUI_portable_torch_2.10.0_cu130_cp313_sageattention_triton/tree/main, also u need download and install CUDA 13.0 (https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-13-0-0-download-archive) and VS Code (https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/downloads/)
